packages/core/src/verify/criteria-observ.message: `SUMMARY_TOKEN` matches bare `SUMMARY` before any extension, so `SUMMARY.mdx`/`.yaml` are marked unobservable. That can suppress a real deep-verify failure.

packages/core/src/services/settle.ts.message: During verifier failure, direct classification only skips the floor. The saved AC still gets `evidence: 'unverified'` and is counted in assurance, violating off-ladder semantics.

packages/types/src/summary.ts.message: The documented presence-only marker accepts `false`. A persisted `unobservable: false` is silently treated as observable; use `z.literal(true).optional()`.
